title: Amazon CloudTrail Event
description: Represents a CloudTrail event record containing information about an API call or account activity.

eventVersion.description: The version of the event log format.

userIdentity.description: Information about the user that made the request.

principalId.description: A unique identifier for the entity that made the call.

arn.description: The ARN of the principal that made the call.

accountId.description: The account that owns the entity that made the call.

userName.description: The friendly name of the identity.

eventTime.description: The date and time the request was made.

eventSource.description: The service that the request was made to.

awsRegion.description: The AWS Region that the request was made to.

sourceIPAddress.description: The IP address that the request was made from.

userAgent.description: The agent through which the request was made.

errorCode.description: The AWS service error if the request returned an error.

errorMessage.description: The error message if the request returned an error.

requestParameters.description: The parameters sent with the request.

responseElements.description: The response element for actions that make changes.

eventID.description: A GUID generated by CloudTrail to uniquely identify each event.

eventType.description: Identifies the type of event that generated the event record.

readOnly.description: Whether the event is a read-only event.

managementEvent.description: Whether the event is a management event.
